item.title: Medication Mix-Up Leaves Knee Surgery Patient Paralyzed

item.dc:creator: Adeel Hassan

item.media:description: Ascension Saint Thomas Hospital Midtown in Nashville said it ordered an emergency halt to all remaining operations scheduled for Aug. 14 after officials noticed serious adverse reactions in four patients.

item.title: Joe Manchin Pushes for More Independents to Join Congress

item.media:description: Former Senator Joe Manchin III and his daughter Heather said they believe the door is open given growing public disillusionment with partisan stalemate and party politics.
